slides.headline: ELON MUSK LAUNCHED 26 SATELLITES AND NOT ONE FAILED

caption:
Elon Musk just deployed 26 next-gen Starlink satellites and announced it on X, the platform he also personally owns.

SpaceX put 26 Starlink V3 satellites in orbit on September 28 and confirmed contact with all 26. Elon Musk announced it on X, the platform he owns, and these new satellites bring faster speeds and higher capacity than the prior generation. This newest, more powerful generation pushes Starlink to 120 countries that cable and fiber have never touched. A man used his own platform to announce his own company's win.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what our team can build for yours.

Sources: X, SpaceX

#starlink #spacex #elonmusk #technology #satellite
pinned_comment: The entire announcement was Musk typing two sentences on a website he personally owns, no external confirmation, and 57,000 people reposted it instantly. Is that how we decide space news now?

editor_override: IMAGE LAW — cover is a plain portrait of Musk in a Tesla sweatshirt against a blank white wall. There is no satellite, no rocket, no SpaceX logo, no story-world background of any kind.
